test_title: PYST 64: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 07 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: A sum of ₹9,960 was borrowed at 7.5% per annum compound interest and paid back in two equal annual instalments. What was the amount of each instalment?
solution:
**Given**

Loan amount = ₹9,960

Interest rate = 7.5% per annum compounded annually

Repayment period = 2 years

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** 

Rate of interest = 7.5%

If Principal = 100

Amount = 107.5

So

Principal : Amount = 100 : 107.5 = 40 : 43

So 

 Principal Installment

First year 40 43

Second year 40² 43²

Both installments are equal so

 Principal Installment 

First year 40 × 43 43 × 43 

Second year 402 432

So

Total Principal = 40 × 43 + 40² = 3320

3320 units = Rs. 9960

1 unit = 3

so

Installment = 43² × 3 = Rs. 5547
